cases.reply: Changing rate without collecting first charges the new percentage for time that elapsed under the old rate.
setRate leaves last unchanged, so collect applies 9% to the day that accrued at 1%.
The fee period lacks a settlement boundary when its price changes, causing an eight-asset overcharge.
The loss comes from either a manipulated timestamp or charging the new fee for old time.
collect can be called twice in the same block to charge the same day twice.
The contract trusts block.timestamp, so a validator can advance the clock and cause an excessive daily fee.
